reuse.why: Adds the check as a shared ensureAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank and uses db.first; it cannot sit in linkBankSyncAccount because only GoCardless uses that and the check must precede findOrCreateBank.

duplication.why: The rule exists once; the only repetition is one guard call added to each of the five pre-existing per-provider link functions, which themselves were already copies.

placement.why: The linking rule lives in the server accounts/link module, the tree's home for link helpers, and is unit-tested there.

scope.why: Focused on the guard and its tests, plus an unrelated reformat of the LinkBankSyncAccountParams type.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition with tests; a future provider must remember to add the guard call since the provider functions are not unified.

one_place.where: accounts/link.ts ensureAccountIsNotLinked, called at the top of all five provider link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking) in accounts/app.ts
